activity_summary: On the way up, the latch stuck in the damp and you did not ask for it to be mended. Alse gave you the short candle and kept the hall's. You said you had a leaf in mind and that the bundle would stay shut. She did not follow you up.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Worked the latch and did not send for a workman.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Named the stick, handed him the short candle, and stayed down.

entities.name: the chamber latch

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: A Wednesday night is a poor reason to mend a door that already knows my hand.

quotes.speaker: alse_pinder
quotes.text: Your candle is the short one.
